## Landscape prompt

Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: production background for an interactive Mongolian eight-player card game, landscape 3:2 composition, 1536 by 1024.
Reference image 1 is the existing game's characters and palette ONLY, not a layout to copy. Reference image 2 is the warm Mongolian room style.
Create a believable photograph-like scene from the eighth player's seat, looking slightly down over a real round green-felt card table in the same warm wooden Mongolian room, subtle mountain sunset and carved timber. Exactly SEVEN adult friends sit around the circumference, NOT all in a line on the far side. Three on the left curving from near left foreground to far left, one opposite the viewer at far center, three on the right curving toward the near right foreground. The eighth seat at bottom center is the viewer and empty/off camera. Faces and seated torsos all clearly distinguishable. Side players genuinely turn inward toward the table, in three-quarter side view, with correct foreshortening and larger nearer figures. Natural arms resting close to the rail, relaxed conversation. Keep all people inside frame.
Maintain the sequence from viewer's left around the far edge to right: young navy-clad man, older brown-clad man, woman in burgundy, woman in dark green at far center, brown-clad man, woman in navy, woman in green at near right. Match the reference's character feel and traditional clothing.
Composition is critical: the seven HEAD centers approximately at normalized positions (0.12,0.55), (0.15,0.32), (0.30,0.16), (0.50,0.12), (0.70,0.16), (0.85,0.32), (0.88,0.55). The large round tabletop occupies central x=0.18 to 0.82, y=0.33 to 0.92; green felt must have a generous clean empty central area for live game cards and labels to be drawn later. Warm solid carved wooden rim, realistic fabric grain, contact shadows and coherent lighting. Far side is raised in perspective, near rim at bottom foreground.
No UI, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no watermarks. NO playing cards anywhere, NO chips, NO cups on felt: these are live overlays in the game. Natural empty hands at the rim, never a fixed card fan. Do not add an eighth visible person. No flat oval pasted over the room. The table and people must share one physically coherent perspective.
